topic: Mathematicians want proof OpenAI didn't use their work
headline: Did OpenAI Use Unverified Math?
caption:
As a full stack engineer, I see the importance of transparency in AI research. When new models draw from academic work, clear attribution matters to maintain trust and integrity. Today’s story highlights the ongoing debate around ethical AI development and respecting intellectual property. We need open conversations on collaboration, proper acknowledgment, and responsible use of mathematical breakthroughs. It’s not just about legal rights but also about fostering an innovative and trustworthy community. What do you think about AI developers verifying sources and giving credit where it’s due? 🤔

#AIethics #OpenAIlove #MathInTech #ResponsibleAI
